item.title: Here’s Where to Buy Affordable Tickets to John Summit’s 2026 CTRL ESCAPE Arena Tour Online
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest news and updates from the music world. Today, we're excited to share with you the upcoming tour dates of DJ John Summit. Get ready to groove to the beats of his sophomore album, CTRL ESCAPE, as he hits the road this fall with a massive arena tour."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The CTRL ESCAPE tour kicks off on October 1st in Champaign, Illinois, and spans 20 dates across the US and Canada. John Summit will be performing in cities like Philadelphia, Boston, DC, Houston, Atlanta, and Chicago, before wrapping up the tour at the Oakland Arena in Oakland, California on December 4th."
[Short music transition]
Host: "If you're looking to catch John Summit live, you can check out official ticketing sites like Ticketmaster, where prices start at around $31.25 for certain venues. For sold-out shows, you can also try resale sites like StubHub and SeatGeek, which offer affordable options with prices starting from $52. Be sure to look out for deals and discounts on these platforms, and don't forget to take advantage of their guarantees and refund policies."
[Short music transition]
Host: "John Summit is also keeping busy this summer with a residency at UNVRS in Ibiza and a headlining spot at Lollapalooza in late July. But if you can't make it to those gigs, the CTRL ESCAPE tour is your best bet to see him live. So mark your calendars and get ready to experience the energy of John Summit's live performance."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. For more information on John Summit's tour dates and ticketing options, visit our website or check out the links in our show notes. Don't miss out on the chance to see John Summit live – get your tickets now and be a part of the CTRL ESCAPE tour!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
